about.title: A space of beauty in Novorossiysk
about.p1: A'LIS is a premium beauty salon and a unique beauty concierge service. We create an atmosphere of care where every detail is considered for your comfort.
about.p2: Our philosophy is to bring together people passionate about their craft and to deliver the highest level of service to every guest.

founder.name: Daiana Tarzian
founder.role: Founder of the ALIS aesthetics studios and A'LIS BEAUTY CONCIERGE
founder.quote: My idea is to bring together people who are passionate about their craft and creativity, to provide quality service and care for every detail, so that guests feel wonderful in a calm atmosphere.

concierge.title: A beauty team travelling to your event
concierge.p1: We create complete turnkey looks for weddings, photoshoots, events and special days — with a team of stylists travelling to any location.
concierge.p2: A full set of professional equipment, a coordinated team and attention to every detail so that you and your guests look impeccable.

items.title: Skill and experience
items.text: Thanks to our expertise in the beauty industry, we easily meet our clients' needs.

items.title: A large team
items.text: The ability to prepare many guests at an event and to send a team of stylists to any location.

items.title: Turnkey complete look
items.text: A versatile team takes care of makeup, hairstyling, clothing and more on the day of the event.

items.title: Commercial offers
items.text: Comfortable service packages for events of any size and for business or creative collaborations.

items.title: Quality equipment
items.text: The team arrives with a full set of equipment: from professional lighting to a garment steamer.

fullLook.title: A complete turnkey look
fullLook.text: We take care of everything: makeup, hairstyling, clothing and accessories. All you have to do is enjoy your event while we ensure an impeccable look.

steps.title: Enquiry form
steps.text: Filling out the form helps us understand your request.

steps.title: Booking the date and discussing details
steps.text: A beauty manager will get in touch to discuss the event details, date, location, look, package, pricing and gifts.

steps.title: The team travels to you
steps.text: A professional, fully equipped team travels to the appointed date and location to create looks for you and your guests.
